# Eileen Jonah — Century 21 North East

> Eileen Jonah is a licensed Realtor® with Century 21 North East, serving
> residential real estate clients across the North Shore of Boston,
> Massachusetts — including Swampscott, Lynn, Marblehead, Salem, Peabody,
> Beverly, Danvers, Nahant, Saugus, and Revere. She has over 20 years of
> real estate experience, was named 2015 REALTOR® of the Year by both the
> North Shore Association of REALTORS® and the Massachusetts Association
> of REALTORS®, and served as 2015 President of NSAR.
